verdict.rationale: Jira documents Rovo AI linking context from Confluence, Figma and third-party apps to work items, progress tracking from tools like Slack and Gmail, Trello sync, and an official MCP server agents can use to reach Jira data. Together these let context travel with the work item across tools, but nothing shows an explicit agent-to-agent or tool-to-tool handoff that preserves full context. missing for 10: documented agent handoff workflow, evidence that context and history are preserved intact on handoff, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-agent continuity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can hand off work between tools or agents without losing context or information

citations.quote: Rovo AI connects relevant assets and rich data from Confluence, Figma, and your 3rd party apps to your work.
Keep work up-to-date by tracking progress from your favorite tools like Slack, Figma and Gmail powered by an AI-assist
Collaborate across tools with transparency and create workflows that work for you by syncing Trello and Jira Software.
